name: WSO2 API Manager
description_en:
WSO2 API Manager is currently presented as API Manager Server, a self-hosted API lifecycle system with Publisher, Developer Portal, gateway and key-management capabilities. Teams expose backend services, publish an API offering, manage consumer subscriptions and enforce access at the gateway.

The former API-management landing page now leads to the wider WSO2 API Platform. This record remains about API Manager Server, distinguishing it from managed cloud and other family products. Starting with 4.7, its product page describes a Java Classic Gateway or a Go Platform Gateway choice; detailed behavior must match the gateway and release selected.
description_zh:
WSO2 API Manager 当前以 API Manager Server 展示，为自托管 API 生命周期系统，包含 Publisher、Developer Portal、网关及密钥管理能力。团队可公开后端服务、发布 API 产品、管理消费者订阅，并在网关执行访问控制。

旧 API 管理入口现进入更广的 WSO2 API Platform。本文仍聚焦 API Manager Server，区分托管云及其他家族产品。产品页说明从 4.7 起可选 Java Classic Gateway 或 Go Platform Gateway；具体行为必须对应所选网关与发行版。

core_features.explanation_en: Issue opaque API-specific keys with environment and optional expiration scope.
core_features.explanation_zh: 签发 API 专属不透明密钥，设置环境及可选有效期。

core_features.explanation_en: Block a selected API/application subscription, with cache-dependent enforcement timing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 阻断选定 API／应用订阅，生效时间取决于缓存。

en: Evaluate Publisher-to-subscription access for one API
Test subscription blocking versus key revocation timing
zh: 评估一个 API 从发布到订阅的访问
测试订阅阻断与 key 撤销的时间差异
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose a Server release and gateway, then verify its JDK/database prerequisites.
steps.zh: 选择 Server 版本及网关，核对 JDK／数据库前提。

steps.en: Use a disposable backend and explicitly configure publication, subscription and credentials.
steps.zh: 用可丢弃后端，明确配置发布、订阅及凭据。

steps.en: Check wrong-API access, key rotation and cached subscription-block behavior before real consumers.
steps.zh: 接入真实消费者前检查错误 API 访问、key 轮换及缓存订阅阻断行为。

items.en: Subscription cache can delay block/unblock; scope is a selected API/application relationship.
items.zh: 订阅缓存可能延迟阻断／解除，范围为选定 API／应用关系。

items.en: 4.7 API-bound keys and Classic timeout settings must not be generalized across older releases or all gateways.
items.zh: 4.7 API 专属 key 及 Classic 超时设置不能泛化至旧版本或全部网关。

items.en: A quickstart JVM topology and baseline resources are not a production capacity guarantee.
items.zh: Quickstart JVM 拓扑及资源基线不是生产容量保证。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Publishing and consumer access are connected steps
sections.title_zh: 发布及消费者访问是相连步骤
sections.en: A proposed evaluation could proxy a disposable order-status service. Define the API context/version/backend in Publisher, deploy it to a gateway and publish it in Developer Portal. Create an application/subscription and test with its access token. The current quickstart combines Create & Publish for its sample, but the underlying concerns remain definition, deployment, discovery and access. Test a permitted and a rejected call, not merely a visible portal entry. No server or request was operated during this research.
sections.zh: 建议以可丢弃订单状态服务做代理试验。在 Publisher 定义上下文／版本／后端，部署网关并发布到 Developer Portal，创建应用／订阅，再用访问 token 测试。当前 Quickstart 为示例合并 Create & Publish，但仍需处理定义、部署、发现及访问。应测试允许和拒绝请求，不能只确认门户有条目。本次未运行服务器或请求。

sections.title_en: API keys have release-specific scope and defaults
sections.title_zh: API key 范围与默认值依版本而异
sections.en: The current guide introduces API-bound opaque keys from 4.7: one key is scoped to one API and can target production or sandbox. A subscription-enabled API also requires a valid application subscription and key association; a subscriptionless API does not. Default keys do not expire unless validity is set. Regeneration revokes the prior key and preserves application association. Do not use older application-key assumptions for the newer model. Test wrong-API, expired and rotated keys in the selected release.
sections.zh: 当前指南说明 4.7 起提供 API 专属不透明 key，一个 key 限一个 API，可选生产或沙盒。要求订阅的 API 还需有效应用订阅及 key 关联，不要求订阅的则不需。默认 key 不到期，需主动设有效期。重新生成会撤销旧 key，保留应用关联。不能将旧应用级 key 假设套用新模型，应在选定版本测试错误 API、过期及轮换 key。

sections.title_en: A subscription block is not necessarily immediate
sections.title_zh: 阻断订阅不一定立即生效
sections.en: Blocking one API subscription for one application does not automatically block the same customer’s other APIs or other applications. Production-only blocking leaves sandbox access available. The documented default gateway token cache can delay blocking and unblocking until expiry, approximately 15 minutes; the guide describes a regenerated token as a different case. Treat this separately from API-key revocation, whose guide describes immediate invalidation. Test the actual token type and cache configuration before relying on an emergency access-removal time.
sections.zh: 阻断某应用的一项 API 订阅，不会自动阻断同客户其他 API 或应用；仅阻断生产仍保留沙盒。文档说明默认网关 token 缓存可使阻断／解除延迟至到期，约十五分钟，重新生成 token 则另述。需与 API key 撤销分开，后者指南描述立即失效。依赖紧急撤权时间前，应测试实际 token 类型及缓存配置。

sections.title_en: Classic Gateway has more than one timeout
sections.en: The tuning guide distinguishes connection establishment, socket inactivity, global callback wait and endpoint-specific timeout/action. Socket timeout measures inactivity between packets rather than total business-operation duration. It also calls out separate behavior for a default-version API template. Therefore changing one timeout does not establish a complete deadline or rollback policy. Inspect the client, gateway and backend together with a slow disposable service. These Classic Gateway settings must not be copied unexamined to the Go Platform Gateway.
sections.zh: 调优指南区分建连、套接字空闲、全局回调等待及逐端点超时／动作。套接字超时测数据包间空闲，不是业务操作总时长，还提示默认版本 API 模板有单独行为。因此只改一项超时不能确立完整截止或回滚策略。应以缓慢的可丢弃服务一并检查客户端、网关、后端；不能未经核对把 Classic 配置照搬到 Go Platform Gateway。

sections.title_en: The all-in-one package is an evaluation topology
sections.en: The quickstart runs core components in one JVM and currently calls for JDK 21. Prerequisites are runtime/version-specific; the page lists a 4 GB RAM and 10 GB free-space baseline, while real concurrency, logs, backups and databases determine production sizing. WSO2 recommends an industry RDBMS for most enterprise production uses rather than assuming the embedded H2 setup is enough. Verify trusted certificates, credentials, persistence and recovery before deployment. Historical browser/OS examples on the page were not adopted as current recommendations.
sections.zh: Quickstart 把核心组件放一个 JVM，当前要求 JDK 21。前提依运行时／版本而异，页面列 4 GB RAM、10 GB 空间基线，生产容量仍取决于并发、日志、备份及数据库。WSO2 对多数企业生产建议使用行业 RDBMS，不能假设内置 H2 足够。部署前需核对可信证书、凭据、持久化及恢复；未把页面历史浏览器／系统示例作为当前建议。

sections.title_en: Apache software and a production subscription are distinct
sections.title_zh: Apache 软件与生产订阅需区分
sections.en: The dedicated Server page states Apache 2.0 and full source, with no per-gateway fees or usage caps for the described software. That does not make infrastructure, maintenance, supported builds, updates or commercial SLAs free. The broader pricing page separately offers a self-managed API Manager enterprise quote at the customer’s scale and describes commercial production subscriptions. Confirm the distribution, update/support rights and selected gateway in the actual proposal. The published Apache statement is scoped to Server, not every external integration or service.
sections.zh: Server 专页声明 Apache 2.0、完整源码，所述软件无逐网关费用及用量上限，但不代表基础设施、维护、受支持构建、更新或商业 SLA 免费。更广定价页另为自运维 API Manager 按客户规模提供企业报价，并描述商业生产订阅。实际方案需确认发行包、更新／支持权及网关；Apache 声明限定 Server，不适用于每个外部集成或服务。

sections.title_en: Cloud Growth pricing is not the Server license price
sections.title_zh: 云 Growth 起价不是 Server 许可价
sections.en: The current API Platform page shows a 30-day $0 trial with five managed interfaces and one million gateway events, plus Growth from $119/month with stated interface/event bands. Managed interfaces count APIs, MCP servers and LLM proxies. Those cloud/platform meters should not be converted into a Server per-seat or permanent-free claim. For self-managed Server, pricing is a tailored enterprise quote plus customer infrastructure. Exact regional quote, renewal, metered-event definition and overages were not verified here.
sections.zh: 当前 API Platform 页列三十天 $0 试用、五个受管接口及一百万网关事件，Growth 每月 $119 起并列接口／事件范围。受管接口包括 API、MCP server、LLM proxy。这些云／平台计量不能转成 Server 席位价或永久免费声明。自运维 Server 则按规模企业询价，客户另负担基础设施。本次未核实地区报价、续费、事件具体定义及超额。
